svg.text: Local-first LLM orchestrator. argusd keeps the state and decides; workers run plugin code; Helios shows it live.
Core service · always on · Python / FastAPI / SQLite
jobs · steps · events · edges · approvals · outbox
plugin state · Ari turns + memory · samples · lessons
Claims a job, runs it step by step
T1 → T2 → T3, checked in code
Workflow context (what plugin code can call)
step() checkpointed; a retried job skips finished steps
llm() / claude() model calls through the router
approve() / ask_me() parks the job until you answer
tool() another plugin's ability, as a child job
notify() phone message, once per step
files / http / secrets limited to the plugin's manifest
saved() time saved, for the weekly total
Claude; web search for Ari only

Rules: a change, its event and its phone message are written in one transaction · plugins start in dry-run · money always needs your approval, totals computed in code · models return JSON that code checks; Claude runs with tools off.
